<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps<{ modelValue: number; min?: number; max?: number }>()
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [number] }>()

const host = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)

function mountNative() {
  const el = host.value
  if (!el) return
  el.innerHTML = ''
  const input = document.createElement('input')
  input.type = 'range'
  input.className = 'range'
  input.min = String(props.min ?? 0)
  input.max = String(props.max ?? 3)
  input.value = String(props.modelValue)
  input.addEventListener('input', () => emit('update:modelValue', Number(input.value)))
  el.appendChild(input)
}

onMounted(mountNative)
watch(() => props.modelValue, (v) => {
  const input = host.value?.querySelector('input[type=range]') as HTMLInputElement | null
  if (input && Number(input.value) !== v) input.value = String(v)
})
</script>
<template>
  <view ref="host" class="ref8443-range-host" />
</template>
